kite.name: River Watch
kite.line: Hold the fords, trust no rider, and let the mist hide our strength until the final watch.

rhino.name: The Grey Rhino
rhino.line: Slow feet, sealed letters. Nobody reads what we write.

orchid.name: Orchid's Thorn Commander
orchid.line: We bloom where others break — hold the fords, guard the valley, let no rider pass unseen.

tiger.name: Old Stripe
tiger.line: Two riders, two roads. One always gets through.
